full_judgment: 27. We find that, a money suit being Money Suit No. 53 of 1998 and upon a decree, it was initiated Money Decree Case No. 12 of 2000 which then re-numbered as Artha Execution Case No. 601 of 2003 which is now pending. By a letter dated 4-12-2016 issued by writ petitioner No. 2, it asserted that, the writ petitioner No. 2 admitted the claim of writ respondent No. 4 of the loan of 31,00,000 and prayed for providing writ petitioner No. 1 installment to pay it off and even the writ petitioner No. 2 gave a cheque amounting to taka 1,00,000 to respondent No. 4 (though it is dated 4-6-2017).
